bayts.text: The challenge of whoever challenged me is the challenge of one against whom the Avenger (Al-Muntaqim), the Maker (Al-Bāriʾ), brings forth time.
When I ask of my God, He draws (it in); and if I repel (something) through God, He takes it away.
My Lord, the One, has bestowed on me Oneness, ever since He bestowed on me "Say: He is Allah, One" (Qurʾān 112:1).
To Him my ink and my pens against the enemies, and never do I meet whoever has aggressed.
The abasement of whoever challenges Allah, the Majestic (Al-Jalīl), is the abasement of one abased above whom is every abased one.
O you who regard as lord other than God, and as friend other than the most excellent of creation,
my Lord has torn the light from your breast: be, through the illuminator, an illumined seeker.
To the Light (the Prophet) I addressed, in the darknesses, a praise that spared me enemies and shocks.
The praise of the Messenger of Allah — may Allah bless him in the Family and whoever befriends him —
frees from swords and spears: how excellent the brave one, how excellent the effacing warrior (al-Māḥī)!
To the Sea (of bounty, the Prophet) I addressed, upon the sea, a praise through which I became like a sea.
I have presented to the most excellent of creation, on dry land (al-barr), the best praise, and he bestowed on me with kindness (bi-birr).
There has set me forward, on land and sea together, the praise of him who joined land and sea.
He has turned the wishes to me, on land and sea, whose being the best of creation has not remained hidden.
Toward me, on land and sea, the best of creation has inclined the best of openings, with wealth.
There has honoured me, on land and sea, the praise of him whose praise overthrew my enemy with a crash.
My gift, on land and sea, is a eulogy of him through whom harm has turned back from me.
Muḥammad is pious (barr, "land") and a sea (of bounty): his like was not seen in the past, nor will it be seen.
Muḥammad: may Peace (As-Salām) bless him with peace, in his Family and his Companions, the lions.
He has repelled the turning of harm from my side: whoever turns to harm me is fettered.
I have stored as treasure Allah's being for me forever, and His being for me without hardship.
My Lord has been for me, and the Prophet has been for me, with what effaced my fault and kept my secret for me.
It has gladdened me that my God is the One, and that the best of creation is a lion against whoever denied.
Allah has guided me with the guidance (of the community) to which came from Him the Trustee of the religion.
Muḥammad is my means of approach to my Intimate, my Beloved, Who makes my little abundant.
I extol Him to Whom my gratitude goes, and He — the Most High — is perpetually the One I thank.
To Allah my praise and my thanks for my being the servant of him through whom He manifests the heights.
To Allah my praise and my thanks, perpetually, for him for whom my striving has been praised.
The Generous, the Honourer, has honoured me, and through the Honoured (the Prophet) generosity has come to me.
The best of all the worlds is Aḥmad, our Praiser, our Praised, Muḥammad.
An Everlasting One has turned security to me without fear, Who has spared me the causes of fear.
I have rejoiced in Allah, Who has made me secure from every evil, forever, with favours.
Allah has favoured me with being made secure, and has purified the heart of conjecture.
To me Allah leads, through al-Māḥī, the Prophet, what no one sees under any tent.
The Trustworthy (Gabriel), through the Trustworthy (Muḥammad), leads to me what makes bodies comely with vigour.
The Trustworthy has guided me with the hidden, and I have won the open and the concealed.
Al-Māḥī has effaced the turning of harm toward me: I have become free of need of sword and spears.
The Intercessor has come to meet me with the glad tidings that I am the servant of the Light and the Bearer of glad tidings.
The Bearer of glad tidings has guaranteed me clarity from turbidity and bestowed healing.
The Bearer of glad tidings has honoured me with lasting glad tidings: that I am the intimate, the beloved and the servant.
The Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm) has guided me: I do not go astray, and from the way of Allah I am not misled.
Muḥammad: may Allah bless him in the Family, the Companions and whoever befriends him.
He leads wishes to me without troubles, in this abode and in that abode.
My past sorrow has been turned toward others than me, and my being the servant, the servitor, has been recognised.
The clarity of all of me, without lack, has adorned my worship and adorned my services.
I have intended gratitude to Allah for what He made lawful for me, and He has been for me with security and gain.
My face is turned toward the Everlasting, and He leads to me the goal of the foremost.
The Generous, the Honourer, has conversed intimately with me; the Intercessor, the Honoured, has conversed intimately with me.
The Qurʾān and the ḥadīth lead to me that beneath which lie exegesis and transmission.
The Sender (of the Book) has driven to me the best of the Remembrance, and the Everlasting has been for me without guile.
The peace of Him Who has been for me with my aims (be) upon a Bearer of glad tidings who effaced my illnesses,
with his Family, his Companions, the Muslim men and the Muslim women: how excellent the best of the worlds!
I have borne witness that Allah is One Lord, and no denier inclines toward my person.
I have raised my praises to the most excellent of creation, and He has led to me, with my wishes, the sūras.
